```{r circulos-genes, fig.width=30, fig.height=30, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
   # filter(., !grepl("usi",Gene)) %>%
   # filter(., !grepl("osa",Gene)) %>%
   # filter(., !grepl("hrom",Indication.Group)) %>%
    mutate(Gene = str_replace(Gene, ' ', ''))   %>%
      mutate(Gene = ifelse(grepl("ChromosomalBalancedTranslocation", Gene), "Chromosomal Balanced Translocation", Gene)) %>%
      mutate(Gene = ifelse(grepl("ChromosomalDeletion", Gene), "Chromosomal Deletion", Gene)) %>%
      mutate(Gene = ifelse(grepl("ChromosomalAneuploidy", Gene), "Chromosomal Aneuploidy", Gene)) %>%
      mutate(Gene = ifelse(grepl("ChromosomalDuplication", Gene), "Chromosomal Duplication", Gene)) %>%
      mutate(Gene = ifelse(grepl("ChromosomalInversion", Gene), "Chromosomal Inversion", Gene)) %>%
      mutate(Gene = ifelse(grepl("ChromosomalUnbalancedTranslocation", Gene), "Chromosomal Unbalanced Translocation", Gene)) %>%
    separate_rows(., Gene, convert = TRUE, sep = ";") %>%
    separate_rows(., Gene, convert = TRUE, sep = ",") %>%
    group_by(Gene, Classification, Indication.Group) %>%
    count() %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    mutate(Sum = sum(n)) %>%
    filter(Sum >= 1) %>%
    select(Gene, Indication.Group, Classification, n) %>%
    spread(key = Classification, value = n) %>%
    mutate(Pathogenic = replace_na(Pathogenic, 0), VUS = replace_na(VUS, 0)) %>%
    arrange(VUS) %>%
    arrange(-Pathogenic) %>%
    mutate(Indication.Group = as.factor(Indication.Group)) %>%
    mutate(Ratio = (Pathogenic+0.001)/(VUS+0.001)) %>%
    add_column(id = seq(1,as.integer(nrow(.)))) %>%
    ungroup %>% group_by(Indication.Group) %>% mutate(Indication.Count = (length(Indication.Group) + runif(1))) %>%
    mutate(Indication.Count = as.factor(Indication.Count)) %>%
    arrange(Indication.Count)-> circulos

  empty_bar <- 4
  to_add <- data.frame( matrix(NA, empty_bar*nlevels(circulos$Indication.Group), ncol(circulos)) )
  colnames(to_add) <- colnames(circulos)
  to_add$Indication.Group <- rep(levels(circulos$Indication.Group), each=empty_bar)
  to_add$Indication.Count <- rep(levels(circulos$Indication.Count), each=empty_bar)
  circulos <- rbind(circulos, to_add)
  circulos <- circulos %>% arrange(-as.numeric(Indication.Count))
  circulos$id <- seq(1, nrow(circulos))

  label_data <- circulos
  number_of_bar <- nrow(label_data)
  angle <- 90 - 360 * (label_data$id-0.5) /number_of_bar
  label_data$hjust <- ifelse( angle < -90, 1, 0)
  label_data$angle <- ifelse(angle < -90, angle+180, angle)

  base_data <- circulos %>%
    group_by(Indication.Group) %>%
    summarize(start=min(id), end=max(id) - empty_bar) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(title=mean(c(start, end)))
  grid_data <- base_data
  grid_data$end <- grid_data$end[ c( nrow(grid_data), 1:nrow(grid_data)-1)] + 1
  grid_data$start <- grid_data$start - 1
  grid_data <- grid_data[-1,]
  base_data <- bind_cols(base_data, circulos %>% group_by(Indication.Group) %>% mutate(max = max(Pathogenic, na.rm = TRUE), min = max(VUS, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% select(Indication.Group, max, min) %>% distinct %>% arrange(Indication.Group) %>% ungroup() %>% select(-Indication.Group))
  df <- MedGenData_Indications %>%
      group_by(Indication.Group) %>%

      as.data.frame() %>%

  df$Colors <- as.vector(c(stepped2(20),"grey30"))
  base_data <- bind_cols(base_data, df %>% arrange(Indication.Group) %>% .$Colors)
  colnames(base_data) <- c("Indication.Group", "start", "end", "title", "max", "min", "Colors")
  lines <- base_data
  lines <- lines[,1:3]
  lines <- rbind(lines, c("x",493,500))
  lines$start <- as.numeric(lines$start)
  lines$end <- as.numeric(lines$end)

circulos <- circulos %>%
  mutate(Indication.Group = factor(Indication.Group, levels = desired_order))

Plot.Circulos.Genes <- ggplot(circulos, aes(x = as.factor(id))) +

  ## === FULL reference rings ABOVE baseline ===
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 5, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 40, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +

  ## === FULL reference rings BELOW baseline ===
  geom_hline(yintercept = -5, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -10, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -20, color = "grey90", linetype = "dashed", size = 0.3) +

  ## === Sector shading ===
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = (base_data$start - 2),
           xmax = (base_data$end + 2),
           ymin = -(base_data$min + 5),
           ymax = ifelse((base_data$max < 40 & base_data$max > 20), 41,
                         ifelse(base_data$max < 40, base_data$max + 13.5, 65)),
           alpha = .15, fill = base_data$Colors) +

  ## === Bars for Pathogenic and VUS ===
  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
  geom_bar(aes(y = Pathogenic, fill = "fill1"), stat = "identity", alpha = 1) +
  geom_bar(aes(y = -VUS, fill = "fill2"), stat = "identity", alpha = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("fill1" = "dodgerblue2", "fill2" = "salmon2")) +

  ## === Gene name labels ===
  geom_text(data = label_data,
            aes(x = id, y = ifelse(Pathogenic == 0, 2, Pathogenic + 1),
                label = Gene, hjust = hjust),
            color = "black", fontface = "italic", alpha = 0.6, size = 2,
            angle = label_data$angle, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  ## === Indication group labels ===
  geom_text(
    data = base_data %>%
      add_column(label = base_data$Indication.Group) %>%
      mutate(across('label', str_replace, 'Gastrointestinal', 'GI')) %>%
      mutate(across('label', str_replace, ' disorder', '')) %>%
      mutate(across('label', str_replace, ' ', '\n')) %>%
      mutate(across('label', str_replace, '/', '/\n')),
    aes(x = as.numeric(title),
        y = -(min + 10),
        label = label,
        color = Indication.Group),
    alpha = 0.8, size = 7, lineheight = 0.75, fontface = "bold",
    hjust = ifelse(base_data$title / max(base_data$title) <= 0.5, 1, 0),
    angle = (90 - 360 * ((ifelse(base_data$title / max(base_data$title) <= 0.5,
                                 base_data$title / max(base_data$title),
                                 (base_data$title * 0.99) / max(base_data$title) - 0.5)))),
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Gastrointestinal disorder" = "#393B79",
    "Cardiac disorder" = "#5254A3",
    "Ear/eye disorder" = "#6B6ECF",
    "Skin/Tooth disorder" = "#9C9EDE",
    "Mitochondrial disease" = "#637939",
    "ID/DD/ASD" = "#8CA252",
    "Lung disorder" = "#B5CF6B",
    "Neuromuscular disorder" = "#CEDB9C",
    "Endocrine disorder" = "#8C6D31",
    "Immune/hematologic disorder" = "#BD9E39",
    "Bone/Skeletal disorder" = "#E7BA52",
    "Metabolic disorder" = "#E7CB94",
    "Chromosomal disorder" = "#843C39",
    "Renal disorder" = "#AD494A",
    "General genetics" = "#D6616B",
    "Lysosomal storage disorder" = "#E7969C",
    "Vascular malformation disorder" = "#7B4173",
    "Multisystem disorder" = "#A55194",
    "Cancer genetics" = "#CE6DBD",
    "Connective tissue disorder" = "#DE9ED6",
    "Hypermobility" = "grey30"
  )) +

  ## === Reference ring labels ===
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = 0, label = "0",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = 5, label = "5",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = 10, label = "10",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = 20, label = "20",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = 30, label = "30",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = 40, label = "40",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = -5, label = "5",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = -10, label = "10",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = -20, label = "20",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
  annotate("text", x = max(base_data$end) + 3.5, y = 25, label = "Count:",
           hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", angle = 270) +

  ## === Polar coords & theme ===
  ylim(-100, 120) +
  coord_polar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(-1000, -1000, -1000, -1000),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    clip = "off"
  )

# Render it
print(Plot.Circulos.Genes)
```

```{r fig6-chunk, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Interactive table]  Figure 6
## What    : Summary of Gene Variant Counts by Indication Group
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

datatable(
  bind_rows(
    # Keep chromosomal abnormalities untouched (including their spaces)
    MedGenData_Indications %>%
      filter(!is.na(Gene), Gene != "NA", Classification %in% c("Pathogenic", "VUS")) %>%
      filter(grepl("chromo", Gene, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(
        Gene = case_when(
          grepl("ChromosomalBalancedTranslocation", Gene) ~ "Chromosomal Balanced Translocation",
          grepl("ChromosomalDeletion", Gene) ~ "Chromosomal Deletion",
          grepl("ChromosomalAneuploidy", Gene) ~ "Chromosomal Aneuploidy",
          grepl("ChromosomalDuplication", Gene) ~ "Chromosomal Duplication",
          grepl("ChromosomalInversion", Gene) ~ "Chromosomal Inversion",
          grepl("ChromosomalUnbalancedTranslocation", Gene) ~ "Chromosomal Unbalanced Translocation",
          TRUE ~ Gene
        )
      ),

    # For non-chromo entries: remove spaces and split
    MedGenData_Indications %>%
      filter(!is.na(Gene), Gene != "NA", Classification %in% c("Pathogenic", "VUS")) %>%
      filter(!grepl("chromo", Gene, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(Gene = str_replace_all(Gene, " ", "")) %>%
      separate_rows(Gene, sep = ";|,")
  ) %>%

    # Make gene names italic
    mutate(Gene = paste0("<i>", Gene, "</i>")) %>%

    group_by(Gene, Classification, Indication.Group) %>%
    summarise(`Count` = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Classification, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      `Total Variants` = Pathogenic + VUS,
      `Percent Pathogenic` = round(100 * Pathogenic / (`Total Variants` + 0.001), 1),
      `Percent VUS` = round(100 * VUS / (`Total Variants` + 0.001), 1)
    ) %>%
    rename(`Indication Group` = Indication.Group) %>%
    arrange(desc(`Total Variants`)),

  caption = "Summary of Gene Variant Counts by Indication Group",
  escape = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    scrollX = TRUE
  )
)
```

### Bar plots by indication group {.tabset .tabset-pills}

#### Connective Tissue

```{r genes-connective-tissue, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Figure 6 > Detail: genes identified within each indication group > Bar plots by indication group
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## Creates : circulos_ctd
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare data
circulos_ctd <- MedGenRawData2025 %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene), !is.na(Indication_Cleaned), Indication.Group == "Connective tissue disorder") %>%
  filter(Classification %in% c("Pathogenic", "VUS")) %>%
  filter(!grepl("hrom|trans|arr|tris|unba|usi|osa", Gene)) %>%
  separate_rows(Gene, sep = ";|,") %>%
  mutate(Gene = str_replace_all(Gene, " ", "")) %>%
  group_by(Gene, Classification) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Classification, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = Pathogenic + VUS) %>%
  filter(Pathogenic > 0 | VUS > 0) %>%
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, -Pathogenic))

# Plot
ggplot(circulos_ctd, aes(x = Gene)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Pathogenic, fill = "Pathogenic")) +
  geom_col(aes(y = -VUS, fill = "VUS")) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = Pathogenic + 0.5, label = Gene),
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    fontface = "italic",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pathogenic" = "dodgerblue2", "VUS" = "salmon2")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c( (max(circulos_ctd$VUS)*-1)-0.5 , max(circulos_ctd$Pathogenic)+0.5 ), breaks = seq(-100, 100, by = 5)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9)
  ) +
  ylab("Variant Count") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black")
```

```{r genes-cancer, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  filter(!is.na(Gene), !is.na(Indication_Cleaned), Indication.Group == "Endocrine disorder") %>%
  filter(Classification %in% c("Pathogenic", "VUS")) %>%
  filter(!grepl("hrom|trans|arr|tris|unba|usi|osa", Gene)) %>%
  separate_rows(Gene, sep = ";|,") %>%
  mutate(Gene = str_replace_all(Gene, " ", "")) %>%
  group_by(Gene, Classification) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Classification, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = Pathogenic + VUS) %>%
  filter(Pathogenic > 0 | VUS > 0) %>%
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, -Pathogenic))

# Plot
ggplot(circulos_ctd, aes(x = Gene)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Pathogenic, fill = "Pathogenic")) +
  geom_col(aes(y = -VUS, fill = "VUS")) +
  geom_text(
```
```{r genes-metabolic, fig.width=9, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
    aes(y = Pathogenic + 0.1, label = Gene),
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    fontface = "italic",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pathogenic" = "dodgerblue2", "VUS" = "salmon2")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c( (max(circulos_ctd$VUS)*-1)-0.5 , max(circulos_ctd$Pathogenic)+0.5 ), breaks = seq(-100, 100, by = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9)
  ) +
  ylab("Variant Count") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black")
```

```{r genes-lung-disorder, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  filter(!is.na(Gene), !is.na(Indication_Cleaned), Indication.Group == "Lung disorder") %>%
  filter(Classification %in% c("Pathogenic", "VUS")) %>%
  filter(!grepl("hrom|trans|arr|tris|unba|usi|osa", Gene)) %>%
  separate_rows(Gene, sep = ";|,") %>%
  mutate(Gene = str_replace_all(Gene, " ", "")) %>%
  group_by(Gene, Classification) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Classification, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(Total = Pathogenic + VUS) %>%
  filter(Pathogenic > 0 | VUS > 0) %>%
  mutate(Gene = fct_reorder(Gene, -Pathogenic))

# Plot
ggplot(circulos_ctd, aes(x = Gene)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = Pathogenic, fill = "Pathogenic")) +
  geom_col(aes(y = -VUS, fill = "VUS")) +
  geom_text(
    aes(y = Pathogenic + 0.2, label = Gene),
    angle = 90,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0.5,
    fontface = "italic",
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pathogenic" = "dodgerblue2", "VUS" = "salmon2")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c( (max(circulos_ctd$VUS)*-1)-1 , max(circulos_ctd$Pathogenic)+1 ), breaks = seq(-100, 100, by = 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(0.9, 0.9)
  ) +
  ylab("Variant Count") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black")
```

<div class="caption"><span class="caplabel">Manuscript legend</span> Results of all 168 WES/WGS tests sent over the study period. In all panels, bars indicate the percentage of pathogenic (blue), VUS (orange), carrier (yellow), candidate gene (aqua), or negative (gray) results; blue labels give the percent pathogenic. Sample sizes are shown below the axis labels for panels B–E.</div>

### Shared preparation: the WES/WGS subset {#fig7-shared}

<div class="note">These statements are used by more than one panel below, so they run once here. Each panel's own chunk then contains the code specific to that panel.</div>

```{r fig7-shared}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Shared preparation]  Figure 7 > Shared preparation: the WES/WGS subset
## What    : Statements used by more than one panel of this figure; run once here, before the panel chunks.
## Creates : MedGenData_WES, classification_levels
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

###################### Filter to just WES/WGS
MedGenData_WES <- MedGenRawData2025 %>% filter(Test.Category %in% c("WES", "WGS"))

# Define all possible levels
classification_levels <- c("Negative", "VUS", "Carrier", "Candidate Gene", "Pathogenic")
```

## 7A · Results of WES/WGS (with all other testing for comparison) {#fig7a}

<div class="caption"><span class="caplabel">Manuscript legend</span> Overall distribution of results for all 168 patients who underwent WES/WGS. The right-hand pie (all other testing) is shown for comparison and is not part of the manuscript panel.</div>

```{r results-wes, fig.width=15, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Figure 7 > 7A · Results of WES/WGS (with all other testing for comparison)
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## Creates : fill_colors, prep_pie_data, make_pie, wes_data, other_data, plot_wes, plot_other, Plot.Results
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Define fill colors (shared)
fill_colors <- c(
  "Negative" = "grey80",
  "VUS" = "salmon2",
  "Carrier" = "yellow",
  "Candidate Gene" = "cyan3",
  "Pathogenic" = "dodgerblue2"
)

# Function to prepare pie chart data
prep_pie_data <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(Classification = ifelse(Classification == "NA" | is.na(Classification), "Negative", Classification)) %>%
    distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, AGE_RANGE, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    group_by(Classification) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      prop = n / sum(n),
      LABEL = paste0(Classification, " (", round(prop * 100, 1), "%)")
    )
}

# Function to make a pie chart
make_pie <- function(plot_data) {
  legend_labels <- deframe(plot_data %>% select(Classification, LABEL))

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = "", y = prop, fill = factor(Classification, levels = rev(names(fill_colors))))) +
    geom_col(position = "fill") +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colors, labels = legend_labels) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(fill = "Testing Result")
}

# Filter master data
wes_data <- MedGenData %>%
  filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes", Test.Category %in% c("WES", "WGS"))

other_data <- MedGenData %>%
  filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes", !(Test.Category %in% c("WES", "WGS")))

# Prepare and plot
plot_wes <- make_pie(prep_pie_data(wes_data)) + ggtitle("Results of WES/WGS")
plot_other <- make_pie(prep_pie_data(other_data)) + ggtitle("Results of All Other Testing")

# Combine and print
Plot.Results <- plot_wes | plot_other
print(Plot.Results)
```


<details class="stats">
<summary>Stats for WES/WGS Differences in Diagnostic Rate</summary>

```{r wes-stats-results-all, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Statistics]  Figure 7 > 7A · Results of WES/WGS (with all other testing for comparison)
## What    : Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic Result by Test Type (Ref: Other)
## Creates : logistic_data_path, testtype_logit_path, testtype_or_table_path
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare data for logistic regression (Pathogenic vs. all other results)
logistic_data_path <- MedGenData %>%
  filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification),
    ResultBinary = ifelse(Classification == "Pathogenic", 1, 0),
    TestType = ifelse(Test.Category %in% c("WES", "WGS"), "WES/WGS", "Other")
  )

# Fit logistic model
testtype_logit_path <- glm(ResultBinary ~ TestType, data = logistic_data_path, family = binomial())

# Format results as Odds Ratios with 95% CI and scientific p-values
testtype_or_table_path <- tidy(testtype_logit_path, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(
    `Odds Ratio (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    `p-value` = formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) %>%
  select(`Predictor` = term, `Odds Ratio (95% CI)`, `p-value`)

# Display table
DT::datatable(
  testtype_or_table_path,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic Result by Test Type (Ref: Other)",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 5,
    scrollX = TRUE
  )
)
```
</details>

<details class="stats">
<summary>Stats for WES/WGS Differences in Diagnostic Rate, Adjusted for Covariates</summary>

```{r wes-stats-results-all-cov, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Statistics]  Figure 7 > 7A · Results of WES/WGS (with all other testing for comparison)
## What    : Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic Result by Test Type (Adjusted for Indication Group and Age; Ref: Other)
## Creates : logistic_data_path, testtype_logit_path, testtype_or_table_path
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare data for logistic regression (Pathogenic vs. all other results)
logistic_data_path <- MedGenData %>%
  filter(
    Testing_Sent == "Yes",
    !is.na(Classification),
    !is.na(Test.Category),
    !is.na(Indication.Group),
    !is.na(VISIT_AGE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification),
    ResultBinary = ifelse(Classification == "Pathogenic", 1, 0),
    TestType = ifelse(Test.Category %in% c("WES", "WGS"), "WES/WGS", "Other"),
    Indication.Group = factor(Indication.Group),
    VISIT_AGE = as.numeric(VISIT_AGE),
    TestType = factor(TestType, levels = c("Other", "WES/WGS"))  # Ensure "Other" is reference
  )

# Fit logistic regression model with adjustment for age and indication
testtype_logit_path <- glm(
  ResultBinary ~ TestType + Indication.Group + VISIT_AGE,
  data = logistic_data_path,
  family = binomial()
)

# Format odds ratios for TestType only
testtype_or_table_path <- broom::tidy(testtype_logit_path, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "TestTypeWES/WGS") %>%
  mutate(
    `Predictor` = "WES/WGS vs. Other",
    `Odds Ratio (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    `p-value` = formatC(p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) %>%
  select(`Predictor`, `Odds Ratio (95% CI)`, `p-value`)

# Display table
DT::datatable(
  testtype_or_table_path,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic Result by Test Type (Adjusted for Indication Group and Age; Ref: Other)",
  options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r fig7b-wes-results-by-sex, fig.width=10, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Figure 7 > 7B · WES/WGS results, by sex
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## Creates : plot_data, x_axis_labels, label_pathogenic, Testing.Results.Plot.Gender
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

###################### Testing Results by Gender

plot_data <- MedGenData_WES %>% filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(Classification = ifelse(Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification)) %>%
  select(PAT_MRN_ID, Testing_Sent, GENDER, Result, Classification) %>%
  filter(GENDER != "X") %>%
  distinct(.keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(Testing_Sent)) %>%
  arrange(PAT_MRN_ID) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, GENDER, .keep_all = TRUE, ) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), "Negative") %>%
  group_by(GENDER, Classification) %>%
  count(Classification) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(GENDER) %>%
  mutate(num = (n)) %>%
  mutate(n = prop.table(n)) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  group_by(GENDER) %>%
  mutate(num=sum(num)) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  mutate(
    GENDER_LABEL = paste0(GENDER, "\n(n = ", num, ")")
  )

# Create x-axis labels
x_axis_labels <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(GENDER, GENDER_LABEL) %>%
  deframe()

# Create label data
label_pathogenic <- plot_data %>%
    complete(
        GENDER,
        Classification = classification_levels,
        fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(Classification == "Pathogenic") %>%
    mutate(
        label = sprintf("%.1f%%", n * 100)
    )

# Plot
Testing.Results.Plot.Gender <-  ggplot(data = plot_data,
    aes(
      x = GENDER,
      y = n,
      fill = factor(Classification, levels =
                      c("Negative", "VUS", "Carrier", "Candidate Gene", "Pathogenic")))) +
  geom_col(position = 'fill') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ylab("Result Obtained (Percent)") +
  xlab("EHR-Reported Sex") +
  labs(fill="Testing Result") +
  scale_x_discrete( labels = x_axis_labels) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =
                      c("Negative" = "grey80", "VUS" = "salmon2", "Carrier" = "yellow", "Candidate Gene" = "cyan3", "Pathogenic" = "dodgerblue2")) +
  geom_text(
  data = label_pathogenic,
  aes(x = GENDER, y = 1.025, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "dodgerblue2",
  size = 3,
) +
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  ) +
  ggtitle("WES/WGS Results by Sex") +xlab(NULL)

# ---- display ----

print(Testing.Results.Plot.Gender +ggtitle(""))
```

```{r wes-by-gender-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Interactive table]  Figure 7 > 7B · WES/WGS results, by sex
## What    : Counts and Percentages of WES/WGS Test Results by EHR-Reported Sex
## Creates : wes_summary_table
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Create summarized and reshaped data table
wes_summary_table <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes", GENDER != "X") %>%
  mutate(Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification)) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, GENDER, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(GENDER, Classification) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(GENDER, Classification, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(GENDER) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = GENDER,
    values_from = c(n, pct),
    names_glue = "{GENDER} ({.value})",
    values_fill = list(n = 0, pct = 0)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(contains("(pct)"), ~ scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)(.x))) %>%
  rename(`Test Result Classification` = Classification)

# Display datatable with filters
datatable(
  wes_summary_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    scrollX = TRUE
  ),
  caption = "Counts and Percentages of WES/WGS Test Results by EHR-Reported Sex"
)
```

```{r wes-patht-gender-stats, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Statistics]  Figure 7 > 7B · WES/WGS results, by sex

  select(Variable = term, `OR (CI)` = OR_CI, `p-value` = p.value)

# Display as datatable
datatable(
```

<details class="stats">
<summary>WES/WGS Pathogenic Result Stats by Sex, Adjusted for Indication, Age, and Insurance</summary>

```{r wes-patht-gender-stats-cov, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Statistics]  Figure 7 > 7B · WES/WGS results, by sex
## What    : Odds of Pathogenic Result: Male vs Female (Adjusted for Indication, Age, Insurance Class)
## Creates : reg_data, fit, summary_table
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

reg_data <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  filter(
    Testing_Sent == "Yes",
    GENDER %in% c("Male", "Female"),
    !is.na(Classification),
    !is.na(Indication.Group),
    !is.na(VISIT_AGE),
    !is.na(FINANCIAL_CLASS), FINANCIAL_CLASS != "NA"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification),
    ResultBinary = ifelse(Classification == "Pathogenic", 1, 0),
    GENDER = factor(GENDER, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Indication.Group = factor(Indication.Group),
    VISIT_AGE = as.numeric(VISIT_AGE),
    INSURANCE_CLASS = dplyr::case_when(
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Blue Cross", "Blue Shield", "Commercial", "Managed Care") ~ "Commercial",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Medicare", "Managed Medicare") ~ "Medicare",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Managed Medicaid", "Medicaid (MA)") ~ "Medicaid",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS == "Self-Pay" ~ "Self-Pay",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    INSURANCE_CLASS = factor(INSURANCE_CLASS)
  ) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, GENDER, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Logistic regression adjusted for Indication, Age, and Insurance class
fit <- glm(
  ResultBinary ~ GENDER + Indication.Group + VISIT_AGE + INSURANCE_CLASS,
  data = reg_data,
  family = binomial
)

# Extract and tidy results: Only show gender effect row (Male vs Female)
summary_table <- tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "GENDERMale") %>%
  mutate(
    `OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    `p-value` = formatC(p.value, digits = 2, format = "e")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Predictor = term,
    `OR (95% CI)`,
    `p-value`
  )

DT::datatable(
  summary_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Odds of Pathogenic Result: Male vs Female (Adjusted for Indication, Age, Insurance Class)",
  options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE)
)
```

<summary>WES/WGS VUS Result Stats by Sex, Adjusted for Indication, Age, Insurance Class</summary>

```{r wes-vus-gender-stats-cov, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Statistics]  Figure 7 > 7B · WES/WGS results, by sex
## What    : Odds of VUS Result: Male vs Female (Adjusted for Indication, Age, Insurance Class)
## Creates : reg_data_vus, fit_vus, summary_table_vus
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

reg_data_vus <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  filter(
    Testing_Sent == "Yes",
    GENDER %in% c("Male", "Female"),
    !is.na(Classification),
    !is.na(Indication.Group),
    !is.na(VISIT_AGE),
    !is.na(FINANCIAL_CLASS), FINANCIAL_CLASS != "NA"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification),
    ResultBinary = ifelse(Classification == "VUS", 1, 0),
    GENDER = factor(GENDER, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    Indication.Group = factor(Indication.Group),
    VISIT_AGE = as.numeric(VISIT_AGE),
    INSURANCE_CLASS = dplyr::case_when(
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Blue Cross", "Blue Shield", "Commercial", "Managed Care") ~ "Commercial",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Medicare", "Managed Medicare") ~ "Medicare",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Managed Medicaid", "Medicaid (MA)") ~ "Medicaid",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS == "Self-Pay" ~ "Self-Pay",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    INSURANCE_CLASS = factor(INSURANCE_CLASS)
  ) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, GENDER, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Logistic regression adjusted for Indication, Age, and Insurance class
fit_vus <- glm(
  ResultBinary ~ GENDER + Indication.Group + VISIT_AGE + INSURANCE_CLASS,
  data = reg_data_vus,
  family = binomial
)

# Extract and tidy results: Only show gender effect row (Male vs Female)
summary_table_vus <- tidy(fit_vus, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "GENDERMale") %>%
  mutate(
    `OR (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    `p-value` = formatC(p.value, digits = 2, format = "e")
  ) %>%
  select(
    Predictor = term,
    `OR (95% CI)`,
    `p-value`
  )

DT::datatable(
  summary_table_vus,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Odds of VUS Result: Male vs Female (Adjusted for Indication, Age, Insurance Class)",
  options = list(dom = 't', paging = FALSE)
)
```

## 7C · WES/WGS results, by age {#fig7c}

<div class="caption"><span class="caplabel">Manuscript legend</span> WES/WGS results by age range. No association between age (continuous) and the odds of a pathogenic or VUS result; logistic regression adjusted for insurance class and indication group.</div>

```{r fig7c-wes-results-by-age, fig.width=10, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Figure 7 > 7C · WES/WGS results, by age
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## Creates : plot_data, x_axis_labels, label_pathogenic, Testing.Results.Plot.Age
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

###################### Testing Results by Age

plot_data <- MedGenData_WES %>% filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(AGE_RANGE = cut(VISIT_AGE, breaks = c(0, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, 120))) %>%
  mutate(Classification = ifelse(Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification)) %>%
  select(PAT_MRN_ID, Testing_Sent, AGE_RANGE, Result, Classification) %>%
  distinct(.keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(Testing_Sent)) %>%
  arrange(PAT_MRN_ID) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, AGE_RANGE, .keep_all = TRUE, ) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), "Negative") %>%
  group_by(AGE_RANGE, Classification) %>%
  count(Classification) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(AGE_RANGE) %>%
  mutate(num = (n)) %>%
  mutate(n = prop.table(n)) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  group_by(AGE_RANGE) %>%
  mutate(num=sum(num)) %>%
  ungroup %>%
mutate(
  AGE_LABEL = case_when(
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(0,25]"    ~ "<25",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(25,35]"   ~ "26–35",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(35,45]"   ~ "36–45",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(45,55]"   ~ "46–55",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(55,65]"   ~ "56–65",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(65,120]"   ~ ">65",
    TRUE ~ as.character(AGE_RANGE)  # fallback
  ),
  AGE_LABEL = paste0(AGE_LABEL, "\n(n = ", num, ")")
)

# Create x-axis labels
x_axis_labels <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(AGE_RANGE, AGE_LABEL) %>%
  deframe()

# Create label data
label_pathogenic <- plot_data %>%
    complete(
        AGE_RANGE,
        Classification = classification_levels,
        fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(Classification == "Pathogenic") %>%
    mutate(
        label = sprintf("%.1f%%", n * 100)
    )

# Plot
Testing.Results.Plot.Age <-  ggplot(data = plot_data,
    aes(
      x = AGE_RANGE,
      y = n,
      fill = factor(Classification, levels =
                      c("Negative", "VUS", "Carrier", "Candidate Gene", "Pathogenic")))) +
  geom_col(position = 'fill') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ylab("Result Obtained (Percent)") +
  xlab("Age (years)") +
  labs(fill="Testing Result") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_axis_labels) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =
                      c("Negative" = "grey80", "VUS" = "salmon2", "Carrier" = "yellow", "Candidate Gene" = "cyan3", "Pathogenic" = "dodgerblue2")) +
  geom_text(
  data = label_pathogenic,
  aes(x = AGE_RANGE, y = 1.025, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "dodgerblue2",
  size = 3,
) +
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  ) +
  ggtitle("WES/WGS Results by Patient Visit Age") +xlab(NULL) +ylab(NULL)

# ---- display ----

print(Testing.Results.Plot.Age + ggtitle(""))
```

```{r wes-by-age-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Interactive table]  Figure 7 > 7C · WES/WGS results, by age
## What    : Counts and Percentages of WES/WGS Test Results by Age Range
## Creates : wes_age_table_long, wes_age_table_wide, percent_cols, col_names, n_cols, pct_cols
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare summary data
wes_age_table_long <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes") %>%
  mutate(
    AGE_RANGE = cut(VISIT_AGE, breaks = c(0, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, 120)),
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification)
  ) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, AGE_RANGE, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  count(AGE_RANGE, Classification, name = "n") %>%
  complete(AGE_RANGE, Classification, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(AGE_RANGE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%  # percent already (e.g., 45.6)
  ungroup() %>%
mutate(
  AGE_LABEL = case_when(
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(0,25]"    ~ "<25",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(25,35]"   ~ "26–35",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(35,45]"   ~ "36–45",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(45,55]"   ~ "46–55",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(55,65]"   ~ "56–65",
    as.character(AGE_RANGE) == "(65,120]"   ~ ">65",
    TRUE ~ as.character(AGE_RANGE)  # fallback
  ))

# Pivot wide
wes_age_table_wide <- wes_age_table_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Classification,
    names_from = AGE_LABEL,
    values_from = c(n, pct),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  rename(`Test Result Classification` = Classification)

# Format percent columns with % symbol
percent_cols <- grep("^pct_", names(wes_age_table_wide))
wes_age_table_wide[percent_cols] <- lapply(
  wes_age_table_wide[percent_cols],
  function(x) paste0(x, "%")
)

# Identify JS column indices
col_names <- names(wes_age_table_wide)
n_cols <- which(grepl("^n_", col_names)) - 1
pct_cols <- which(grepl("^pct_", col_names)) - 1

# Render DataTable
datatable(
  wes_age_table_wide,
  extensions = "Buttons",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    scrollX = TRUE,
    pageLength = 10,
    buttons = list(
      list(
        extend = "colvisGroup",
        text = "Show Percents",
        show = pct_cols,
        hide = n_cols
      ),
      list(
        extend = "colvisGroup",
        text = "Show Counts",
        show = n_cols,
        hide = pct_cols
      )
    ),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(visible = TRUE, targets = pct_cols),
      list(visible = FALSE, targets = n_cols),
      list(className = 'dt-center', targets = c(n_cols, pct_cols))
    )
  ),
  caption = "Counts and Percentages of WES/WGS Test Results by Age Range"
)
```

```{r wes-patht-age-stats, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Statistics]  Figure 7 > 7C · WES/WGS results, by age
## What    : Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic WES/WGS Result per Year of Age
## Creates : wes_age_regression_data, wes_age_logit, wes_age_or_table
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare data for logistic regression
wes_age_regression_data <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes", !is.na(VISIT_AGE)) %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification),
    ResultBinary = ifelse(Classification == "Pathogenic", 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, VISIT_AGE, ResultBinary, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Run logistic regression
wes_age_logit <- glm(ResultBinary ~ VISIT_AGE, data = wes_age_regression_data, family = binomial())

# Summarize with odds ratio and confidence intervals
wes_age_or_table <- broom::tidy(wes_age_logit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
  filter(term == "VISIT_AGE") %>%
  mutate(
    `Odds Ratio (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    `p-value` = signif(p.value, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Predictor = term, `Odds Ratio (95% CI)`, `p-value`)

# Display table
DT::datatable(
  wes_age_or_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic WES/WGS Result per Year of Age",
  options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r wes-vus-age-stats, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

## 7E · WES/WGS results, by indication {#fig7e}

<div class="caption"><span class="caplabel">Manuscript legend</span> WES/WGS results by indication group, ordered by likelihood of a pathogenic result. ID/DD/ASD had significantly higher odds of a pathogenic result than the overall WES/WGS average (asterisk); no indication differed for VUS. Logistic regression adjusted for age, sex, race and insurance class, corrected across 21 groups.</div>

```{r fig7e-wes-results-by-indication, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Figure 7 > 7E · WES/WGS results, by indication
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## Creates : plot_data, x_axis_labels, plotting_order, label_pathogenic, Testing.Results.Plot.Indications
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

###################### Testing Results by Indication

plot_data <- MedGenData_WES %>% filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes") %>%
  filter(Indication.Group != "NA") %>%
  mutate(Classification = ifelse(Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification)) %>%
  select(PAT_MRN_ID, Testing_Sent, Indication.Group, Result, Classification) %>%
  distinct(.keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(desc(Testing_Sent)) %>%
  arrange(PAT_MRN_ID) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, Indication.Group, .keep_all = TRUE, ) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), "Negative") %>%
  group_by(Indication.Group, Classification) %>%
  count(Classification) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Indication.Group) %>%
  mutate(num = (n)) %>%
  mutate(n = prop.table(n)) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  group_by(Indication.Group) %>%
  mutate(num=sum(num)) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  mutate(
    Indication.Group_LABEL = paste0(Indication.Group, "\n(n = ", num, ")")
  )

# Create x-axis labels
x_axis_labels <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(Indication.Group, Indication.Group_LABEL) %>%
  deframe()

# Testing Sent order
plotting_order <- c(plot_data %>%
  filter(Classification == "Pathogenic") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  pull(Indication.Group), "Ear/eye disorder", "Cancer genetics", "Hypermobility")

# Create label data
label_pathogenic <- plot_data %>%
    complete(
        Indication.Group,
        Classification = classification_levels,
        fill = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(Classification == "Pathogenic") %>%
    mutate(
        label = sprintf("%.1f%%", n * 100)
    )

# Plot
Testing.Results.Plot.Indications <-  ggplot(data = plot_data %>% mutate(Indication.Group = factor(Indication.Group, levels = plotting_order)),
    aes(
      x = Indication.Group,
      y = n,
      fill = factor(Classification, levels =
                      c("Negative", "VUS", "Carrier", "Candidate Gene", "Pathogenic")))) +
  geom_col(position = 'fill') +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ylab("Result Obtained (Percent)") +
  xlab("Indication Group") +
  labs(fill="Testing Result") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = x_axis_labels) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =
                      c("Negative" = "grey80", "VUS" = "salmon2", "Carrier" = "yellow", "Candidate Gene" = "cyan3", "Pathogenic" = "dodgerblue2")) +
  geom_text(
  data = label_pathogenic,
  aes(x = Indication.Group, y = 1.025, label = label),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  color = "dodgerblue2",
  size = 3,
)  +
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  ) +
  ggtitle("WES/WGS Results by Visit Indication") +xlab(NULL)

# ---- display ----

print(Testing.Results.Plot.Indications + ggtitle(""))
```

```{r wes-by-indication-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Interactive table]  Figure 7 > 7E · WES/WGS results, by indication
## What    : WES/WGS Test Results by Indication Group (Counts and Percents)
## Creates : wes_indication_table_long, wes_indication_table_wide, col_names, n_cols, pct_cols
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Step 1: Prepare long-format table
wes_indication_table_long <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  filter(Testing_Sent == "Yes", Indication.Group != "NA") %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification)
  ) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, Indication.Group, Classification, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  count(Indication.Group, Classification, name = "n") %>%
  complete(Indication.Group, Classification, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(Indication.Group) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Step 2: Pivot wider — Indication as rows, each classification has n_ and pct_ columns
wes_indication_table_wide <- wes_indication_table_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Indication.Group,
    names_from = Classification,
    values_from = c(n, pct),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{Classification}"
  ) %>%
  rename(`Indication Group` = Indication.Group)

# Step 3: Identify column indices for toggling
col_names <- names(wes_indication_table_wide)
n_cols <- which(grepl("^n_", col_names)) - 1  # JS is 0-indexed
pct_cols <- which(grepl("^pct_", col_names)) - 1

# Step 4: Format percent columns with "%"
wes_indication_table_wide <- wes_indication_table_wide %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("pct_"), ~ paste0(.x, "%")))

# Step 5: Render interactive datatable
datatable(
  wes_indication_table_wide,
  extensions = "Buttons",
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    scrollX = TRUE,
    pageLength = 10,
    buttons = list(
      list(
        extend = "colvisGroup",
        text = "Show Percents",
        show = pct_cols,
        hide = n_cols
      ),
      list(
        extend = "colvisGroup",
        text = "Show Counts",
        show = n_cols,
        hide = pct_cols
      )
    ),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(visible = TRUE, targets = pct_cols),
      list(visible = FALSE, targets = n_cols)
    )
  ),
  caption = "WES/WGS Test Results by Indication Group (Counts and Percents)"
)
```

<summary>WES/WGS Pathogenic Result Stats by Indication, Adjusted for Age, Sex, Race, Insurance Class</summary>

```{r wes-patht-indication-stats-cov, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Statistics]  Figure 7 > 7E · WES/WGS results, by indication
## What    : Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic Result by Indication Group vs All Other Groups (WES/WGS only, adjusted for Age, Race, Insurance Class)
## Creates : wes_logo_data, groups, logo_results
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare the dataset (WES/WGS patients, Pathogenic vs. Other)
wes_logo_data <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  filter(
    Testing_Sent == "Yes",
    !is.na(RACE), !is.na(Classification), !is.na(Indication.Group),
    !is.na(VISIT_AGE),
    !is.na(FINANCIAL_CLASS), FINANCIAL_CLASS != "NA"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification),
    ResultBinary = ifelse(Classification == "Pathogenic", 1, 0),
    VISIT_AGE = as.numeric(VISIT_AGE),
    RACE = factor(RACE),
    INSURANCE_CLASS = dplyr::case_when(
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Blue Cross", "Blue Shield", "Commercial", "Managed Care") ~ "Commercial",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Medicare", "Managed Medicare") ~ "Medicare",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS %in% c("Managed Medicaid", "Medicaid (MA)") ~ "Medicaid",
      FINANCIAL_CLASS == "Self-Pay" ~ "Self-Pay",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    INSURANCE_CLASS = factor(INSURANCE_CLASS),
    Indication.Group = factor(Indication.Group)
  ) %>%
  distinct(PAT_MRN_ID, Indication.Group, ResultBinary, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Get all indication groups
groups <- levels(wes_logo_data$Indication.Group)

# Loop through each group and compare it to all others
logo_results <- lapply(groups, function(g) {
  dat <- wes_logo_data %>%
    mutate(InGroup = ifelse(Indication.Group == g, 1, 0))

  fit <- glm(ResultBinary ~ InGroup + VISIT_AGE + RACE + INSURANCE_CLASS,
             data = dat, family = binomial())

  broom::tidy(fit, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == "InGroup") %>%
    mutate(Indication.Group = g)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Adjust p-values
logo_results <- logo_results %>%
  mutate(
    `Odds Ratio (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    `p-value` = p.value,
    `Bonferroni p-value` = p.adjust(p.value, method = "bonferroni"),
    `Direction of Difference` = case_when(
      `Bonferroni p-value` < 0.05 & estimate > 1 ~ "Higher Pathogenic Rate",
      `Bonferroni p-value` < 0.05 & estimate < 1 ~ "Lower Pathogenic Rate",
      TRUE ~ "No Difference"
    ),
    `p-value` = formatC(`p-value`, digits = 2, format = "e"),
    `Bonferroni p-value` = formatC(`Bonferroni p-value`, digits = 2, format = "e")
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Indication.Group`, `Odds Ratio (95% CI)`, `p-value`, `Bonferroni p-value`, `Direction of Difference`
  )

# Display interactive table
DT::datatable(
  logo_results,
  rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Odds of Receiving a Pathogenic Result by Indication Group vs All Other Groups (WES/WGS only, adjusted for Age, Race, Insurance Class)",
  options = list(pageLength = 20, scrollX = TRUE)
)
```

```{r wes-overall-data-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Interactive table]  Figure 7 > Table: all WES/WGS results
## What    : Summary of Individuals with WES/WGS Testing
## Creates : individual_summary_table
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Prepare data
individual_summary_table <- MedGenData_WES %>%
  mutate(
    Classification = ifelse(is.na(Classification) | Classification == "NA", "Negative", Classification),
    Gene = ifelse(is.na(Gene) | Gene == "NA", "None Reported", Gene),
    Indication_Cleaned = ifelse(is.na(Indication_Cleaned) | Indication_Cleaned == "NA", "Not Reported", Indication_Cleaned),
    Indication.Group = ifelse(is.na(Indication.Group) | Indication.Group == "NA", "Not Grouped", Indication.Group),
    Test.Category = ifelse(is.na(Test.Category) | Test.Category == "NA", "Not Specified", Test.Category),
    NEW_FOLLOWUP = ifelse(is.na(NEW_FOLLOWUP) | NEW_FOLLOWUP == "NA", "Not Reported", NEW_FOLLOWUP),
    Classification = case_when(
      Classification == "Pathogenic" ~ as.character(span("Pathogenic", style = "color:red")),
      Classification == "VUS" ~ as.character(span("VUS", style = "color:orange")),
      Classification == "Carrier" ~ as.character(span("Carrier", style = "color:goldenrod")),
      Classification == "Negative" ~ as.character(span("Negative", style = "color:grey")),
      TRUE ~ Classification
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    `Patient Age` = VISIT_AGE,
    `Sex` = GENDER,
    `Race` = RACE,
    `Insurance Class` = FINANCIAL_CLASS,
    `Visit Type` = NEW_FOLLOWUP,
    `Visit Indication` = Indication_Cleaned,
    `Indication Group` = Indication.Group,
    `Test Category` = Test.Category,
    `Lab Used` = Lab,
    `Result` = Classification,
    `Gene` = Gene,
    `Secondary Finding` = Secondary
  )

# Render with global escape = FALSE
datatable(
  individual_summary_table,
  filter = "top",
  class = "compact stripe hover",
  escape = FALSE,  # allow HTML rendering
  options = list(
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    autoWidth = TRUE
  ),
  caption = "Summary of Individuals with WES/WGS Testing"
)
```

### S1A · Visit types over time {#figS1a}

<div class="caption"><span class="caplabel">Manuscript legend</span> Type of visit (new patient vs. follow-up, in person vs. telehealth) for all visits, shown over time in 6-month intervals from October 1, 2016, to September 30, 2024. Telehealth was introduced in 2020 with the COVID-19 pandemic and associated stay-at-home orders; it has since declined, particularly for new-patient evaluations, but remains a substantial component of follow-up care.</div>

```{r figs1-visit-types-over-time, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=6.5}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Supplement > Figure S1 · Visit types over time
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## Creates : visit_colors, visit_order, visit_over_time, visit_over_time_complete, p_visittype_time
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# MedGenData_Visits is built once in the data chunk (see top of notebook).

visit_colors <- c(
  "New patient visit" = "#9a19f5",
  "Follow up" = "#eea110",
  "New patient visit, telehealth" = "#bd0ab4",
  "Follow up, telehealth" = "#fbe300")

# Visit order
visit_order <- MedGenData_Visits %>%
  filter(!is.na(VisitType), VisitType != "NA") %>%
  count(Indication.Group, VisitType) %>%
  group_by(Indication.Group) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  filter(VisitType == "New patient visit" | VisitType == "New patient visit, telehealth" ) %>%
  group_by(Indication.Group) %>%
  mutate(prop = sum(prop)) %>%
  filter(VisitType == "New patient visit") %>%
  arrange((prop)) %>%
  pull(Indication.Group)

visit_over_time <- MedGenData_Visits %>%
  filter(!is.na(VisitType), !is.na(CONTACT_DATE_HALF)) %>%
  group_by(CONTACT_DATE_HALF, VisitType) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(CONTACT_DATE_HALF) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(CONTACT_DATE_HALF = as.Date(CONTACT_DATE_HALF))

visit_over_time_complete <- visit_over_time %>%
  tidyr::complete(CONTACT_DATE_HALF, VisitType, fill = list(prop = 0))

p_visittype_time <- ggplot(visit_over_time_complete, aes(x = CONTACT_DATE_HALF, y = prop, fill = VisitType)) +
  geom_area(color = NA) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", date_labels = "%b %Y", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = visit_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Visit Types Over Time",
    x = "Date (by half-year)",

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_visittype_time)
```

### S1B · Visit type, by provider type {#figS1b}

<div class="caption"><span class="caplabel">Manuscript legend</span> Type of visit, by provider type, for all visits with a documented provider. Provider types are physician with genetic counselor, genetic counselor only, and nurse practitioner; visit types are color-coded as in panel A. Numbers of visits are shown beneath each axis label.</div>

```{r figs1-provider-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Shared preparation]  Supplement > Figure S1 > panels B-D
## What    : Provider-type rule (same as Figure 1F), pattern-based visit-type
##           recode, colours, and the test-type order/palette used in Figure 4.
## Creates : provider_type_of, provider_levels, visit_levels, visit_colors_provider,
##           test_type_colors, n_label, provider_base
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

provider_type_of <- function(provider_name) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("BONANNI", provider_name, ignore.case = TRUE)                                                ~ "Nurse Practitioner",
    grepl("NATHANSON|PYERITZ|KALLISH|ROHANIZADEGAN|DRIVAS|\\bNG\\b", provider_name, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Physician + GC",
    TRUE                                                                                               ~ "GC Only"
  )
}
provider_levels <- c("Physician + GC", "GC Only", "Nurse Practitioner")

# New-patient types first so they stack on top of the follow-up types
visit_levels <- c("New patient visit", "New patient visit, telehealth", "Follow up", "Follow up, telehealth")
visit_colors_provider <- c(
  "New patient visit"             = "#9a19f5",
  "New patient visit, telehealth" = "#bd0ab4",
  "Follow up"                     = "#eea110",
  "Follow up, telehealth"         = "#fbe300"
)

# test_type_levels is defined in the Figure 4C chunk; colours keyed by name so they match 4A/4C
test_type_colors <- setNames(ggthemes::tableau_color_pal("Classic Cyclic")(length(test_type_levels)),
                             test_type_levels)

n_label <- function(df) {           # "Provider\n(n = ...)" axis labels
  d <- distinct(df, Provider_Type, n_provider)
  setNames(paste0(d$Provider_Type, "\n(n = ", d$n_provider, ")"), d$Provider_Type)
}

provider_base <- MedGenRawData2025 %>%
  filter(PROVIDER_NAME != "?", !is.na(PROVIDER_NAME), PROVIDER_NAME != "X") %>%
  mutate(
    Provider_Type = factor(provider_type_of(PROVIDER_NAME), levels = provider_levels),
    VisitType = case_when(
      grepl("NEW|NPV", NEW_FOLLOWUP) & grepl("TELE", NEW_FOLLOWUP)            ~ "New patient visit, telehealth",
      grepl("NEW|NPV", NEW_FOLLOWUP)                                          ~ "New patient visit",
      grepl("RETURN|RPV|FOLLOW", NEW_FOLLOWUP) & grepl("TELE", NEW_FOLLOWUP) ~ "Follow up, telehealth",
      grepl("RETURN|RPV|FOLLOW", NEW_FOLLOWUP)                               ~ "Follow up",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    VisitType   = factor(VisitType, levels = visit_levels),
    New_Patient = grepl("NEW|NPV", NEW_FOLLOWUP)
  )
```

```{r figs1b-visit-type-by-provider, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Supplement > Figure S1 > S1B · Visit type, by provider type
## What    : Stacked bars of the four visit types within each provider type.
## Creates : visits_by_provider, p_visittype_provider
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

visits_by_provider <- provider_base %>%
  filter(!is.na(VisitType)) %>%
  count(Provider_Type, VisitType, name = "n", .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(Provider_Type) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n), n_provider = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

p_visittype_provider <- ggplot(visits_by_provider, aes(x = Provider_Type, y = prop, fill = VisitType)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = n_label(visits_by_provider), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = visit_colors_provider, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Percent of Visits", fill = "Visit Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ---- display ----

print(p_visittype_provider)
```

```{r figs1b-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Interactive table]  Supplement > Figure S1 > S1B · Visit type, by provider type
## What    : Visit counts and percentages by provider type, with new-patient and
##           telehealth shares.
## Creates : visits_by_provider_table, visits_by_provider_summary
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

visits_by_provider_table <- visits_by_provider %>%
  mutate(cell = paste0(n, " (", scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), ")")) %>%
  select(VisitType, Provider_Type, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Provider_Type, values_from = cell, values_fill = "0 (0.0%)") %>%
  rename(`Visit Type` = VisitType)

visits_by_provider_summary <- visits_by_provider %>%
  group_by(Provider_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    `Visits (n)`                        = sum(n),
    `New patient (% of visits)`         = sum(n[grepl("New", VisitType)]) / sum(n),
    `Follow-up (% of visits)`           = sum(n[grepl("Follow", VisitType)]) / sum(n),
    `Telehealth (% of all visits)`      = sum(n[grepl("telehealth", VisitType)]) / sum(n),
    `Telehealth (% of new-patient)`     = sum(n[VisitType == "New patient visit, telehealth"]) / sum(n[grepl("New", VisitType)]),
    `Telehealth (% of follow-up)`       = sum(n[VisitType == "Follow up, telehealth"]) / sum(n[grepl("Follow", VisitType)]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(Provider_Type, `Visits (n)`), ~ scales::percent(.x, accuracy = 0.1))) %>%
  rename(`Provider Type` = Provider_Type)

datatable(visits_by_provider_table, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t"),
          caption = "Visit type by provider type: counts and percentages (column percentages)")
datatable(visits_by_provider_summary, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t"),
          caption = "Visit type by provider type: new-patient and telehealth shares")
```

## Figure S2 · Visits by clinical indication and indication group {#figS2}

<div class="caption"><span class="caplabel">Manuscript legend</span> Circular bar plot of the number of patient visits for each unique clinical indication, grouped and color-coded by indication group. For counts > 20, bar height = 20 + n^0.333. Reference rings at 5, 10, 20, 25, 100 and 500 visits.</div>

<div class="zoomable">

```{r figs2-circos-indications, fig.width=30, fig.height=30, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Supplement > Figure S2 · Visits by clinical indication and indication group
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## Creates : Plot.Circulos.Indications, circulos2
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# MedGenData_Indications is built once in the data chunk (see top of notebook).

MedGenData_Indications %>% filter(!is.na(Indication_Cleaned)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Indication_Cleaned, Indication.Group) %>%
    group_by(Indication_Cleaned, Indication.Group) %>%
    count() %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Indication_Cleaned) %>%
    select(Indication_Cleaned, Indication.Group, n) %>%
    mutate(n = ifelse(n >= 20, 20 + (n)^0.333333, n)) %>%
    arrange(-n) %>%
    mutate(Indication.Group = as.factor(Indication.Group)) %>%
    add_column(id = seq(1,as.integer(nrow(.)))) %>%
    ungroup %>% group_by(Indication.Group) %>% mutate(Indication.Count = (length(Indication.Group) + runif(1))) %>%
    mutate(Indication.Count = as.factor(Indication.Count)) %>%
    arrange(Indication.Count)-> circulos2

  empty_bar <- 4
  to_add <- data.frame( matrix(NA, empty_bar*nlevels(circulos2$Indication.Group), ncol(circulos2)) )
  colnames(to_add) <- colnames(circulos2)
  to_add$Indication.Group <- rep(levels(circulos2$Indication.Group), each=empty_bar)
  to_add$Indication.Count <- rep(levels(circulos2$Indication.Count), each=empty_bar)
  circulos2 <- rbind(circulos2, to_add)
  circulos2 <- circulos2 %>% arrange(-as.numeric(Indication.Count))
  circulos2$id <- seq(1, nrow(circulos2))

  label_data <- circulos2
  number_of_bar <- nrow(label_data)
  angle <- 90 - 360 * (label_data$id-0.5) /number_of_bar
  label_data$hjust <- ifelse( angle < -90, 1, 0)
  label_data$angle <- ifelse(angle < -90, angle+180, angle)

  base_data <- circulos2 %>%
    group_by(Indication.Group) %>%
    summarize(start=min(id), end=max(id) - empty_bar) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(title=mean(c(start, end)))
  grid_data <- base_data
  grid_data$end <- grid_data$end[ c( nrow(grid_data), 1:nrow(grid_data)-1)] + 1
  grid_data$start <- grid_data$start - 1
  grid_data <- grid_data[-1,]
  base_data <- bind_cols(base_data, circulos2 %>% group_by(Indication.Group) %>% mutate(max = max(n, na.rm = TRUE), min = 0) %>% select(Indication.Group, max, min) %>% distinct %>%   arrange(Indication.Group) %>% ungroup() %>% select(-Indication.Group))
  df <- MedGenData_Indications %>% group_by(Indication.Group) %>% count(Indication.Group) %>% arrange(n) %>% as.data.frame(.) %>% select(`Indication.Group`)
  df$Colors <- as.vector(c(stepped2(20),"grey30"))
  base_data <- bind_cols(base_data, df %>% arrange(Indication.Group) %>% .$Colors)
  colnames(base_data) <- c("Indication.Group", "start", "end", "title", "max", "min", "Colors")
  lines <- base_data
  lines <- lines[,1:3]
  lines <- rbind(lines, c("x",460,63))
  lines$start <- as.numeric(lines$start)
  lines$end <- as.numeric(lines$end)

Plot.Circulos.Indications <-  ggplot(circulos2, aes(x=as.numeric(as.factor(id)))) +
    geom_segment(data=lines, aes(x = start-3, y = 0, xend = start-2, yend = 0), alpha=0.25, size = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE )  +
    geom_segment(data=lines, aes(x = start-3, y = 5, xend = start-2, yend = 5), alpha=0.25, size = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE )  +
    geom_segment(data=lines, aes(x = start-3, y = 10, xend = start-2, yend = 10), alpha=0.25, size = 0.3, inherit.aes = FALSE )  +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=20), color="black", alpha=0.25, lwd=0.3) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=22.924017), color="black", alpha=0.25, lwd=0.3) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=24.641588), color="black", alpha=0.25, lwd=0.3) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept=27.937004), color="black", alpha=0.25, lwd=0.3) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 460.5), color="white", alpha=1, lwd=7.75) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = (base_data$start-2), xmax = (base_data$end+2), ymin = -0.5, ymax = (base_data$max +13.5), alpha = .15, fill = base_data$Colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(
      "Gastrointestinal disorder"     = "#393B79",
      "Cardiac disorder"    = "#5254A3",
      "Ear/eye disorder"               = "#6B6ECF",
      "Skin/Tooth disorder"    = "#9C9EDE",
      "Mitochondrial disease"     = "#637939",
      "ID/DD/ASD"                      = "#8CA252",
      "Lung disorder"    = "#B5CF6B",
      "Neuromuscular disorder"    = "#CEDB9C",
      "Endocrine disorder"             = "#8C6D31",
      "Immune/hematologic disorder"   = "#BD9E39",
      "Bone/Skeletal disorder"    = "#E7BA52",
      "Metabolic disorder"             = "#E7CB94",
      "Chromosomal disorder"    = "#843C39",
      "Renal disorder"    = "#AD494A",
      "General genetics"               = "#D6616B",
      "Lysosomal storage disorder"   = "#E7969C",
      "Vascular malformation disorder" = "#7B4173",
      "Multisystem disorder"           = "#A55194",
      "Cancer genetics"     = "#CE6DBD",
      "Connective tissue disorder"     = "#DE9ED6",
      "Hypermobility"     = "grey30"
    )) +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_bar(data = circulos2, aes(y=n, fill = "fill1"), stat="identity", alpha=1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values= c("fill1" = "dodgerblue2")) +
   ylim(-20,NA) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
    ) +
    coord_polar() +
    #annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 460, ymin =20, ymax = 22, alpha = 1, fill ="white") +
    geom_text(data=label_data, aes(size=n, x=id, y= ifelse(n == 0, 2, n +0.5), label=Indication_Cleaned, hjust=hjust), color="grey20",alpha=0.9, angle= label_data$angle, inherit.aes = FALSE ) +
scale_size_continuous(
  range = c(1.5, 4),        # <- smallest n → size 2; largest n → size 6 (you can tweak)
  guide = "none"
) +
    geom_text(data=base_data %>% add_column(label = base_data$Indication.Group) %>%  mutate(across('label', str_replace, 'Gastrointestinal', 'GI')) %>%  mutate(across('label', str_replace, ' disorder', '')) %>%  mutate(across('label', str_replace, ' ', '\n')) %>%  mutate(across('label', str_replace, '/', '/\n') %>%  mutate(across('label', str_replace, 'ID/\nDD/ASD', 'ID/DD/ASD'))), aes(x = as.numeric(title), y = -2, label = label, color = Indication.Group), alpha=0.8, size=7, lineheight = 0.75, fontface="bold", hjust = ifelse(base_data$title/max(base_data$title) <= 0.5, 1, 0),  angle= (90 - 360 * ((ifelse(base_data$title/max(base_data$title) <= 0.5, base_data$title/max(base_data$title), (base_data$title *0.99)/max(base_data$title) -0.5)))), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values=c(
      "Gastrointestinal disorder"     = "#393B79",
      "Cardiac disorder"    = "#5254A3",
      "Ear/eye disorder"               = "#6B6ECF",
      "Skin/Tooth disorder"    = "#9C9EDE",
      "Mitochondrial disease"     = "#637939",
      "ID/DD/ASD"                      = "#8CA252",
      "Lung disorder"    = "#B5CF6B",
      "Neuromuscular disorder"    = "#CEDB9C",
      "Endocrine disorder"             = "#8C6D31",
      "Immune/hematologic disorder"   = "#BD9E39",
      "Bone/Skeletal disorder"    = "#E7BA52",
      "Metabolic disorder"             = "#E7CB94",
      "Chromosomal disorder"    = "#843C39",
      "Renal disorder"    = "#AD494A",
      "General genetics"               = "#D6616B",
      "Lysosomal storage disorder"   = "#E7969C",
      "Vascular malformation disorder" = "#7B4173",
      "Multisystem disorder"           = "#A55194",
      "Cancer genetics"     = "#CE6DBD",
      "Connective tissue disorder"     = "#DE9ED6",
      "Hypermobility"     = "grey30"
    )) +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=0, label= "0", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")   +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=5, label= "5", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=10, label= "10", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=20, label= "20", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30")   +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=22.924017, label= "25", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=24.641588, label= "100", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=27.937004, label= "500", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    annotate("text", x=max(base_data$end)+3.5, y=30, label= "Count:", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", angle = 270)

Plot.Circulos.Indications <-  Plot.Circulos.Indications + theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(-300, -300, -300, -300),  # Remove outer space
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    clip = "off"  )

print(Plot.Circulos.Indications)
```

## Table S1 · Indication-to-indication-group mappings, with visit counts {#tabS1}

```{r tables1-indication-mapping, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Interactive table]  Supplement > Table S1 · Indication-to-indication-group mappings, with visit counts
## What    : Summary of Visit Counts and Indication Groups for Each Indication
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

datatable(
  MedGenData_Indications %>%
    filter(!is.na(Indication_Cleaned), Indication_Cleaned != "NA") %>%
    group_by(Indication_Cleaned, Indication.Group) %>%
    summarise(`Number of Visits` = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(`Percent of All Visits` = round(100 * `Number of Visits` / sum(`Number of Visits`), 2)) %>%
    rename(
      `Indication` = Indication_Cleaned,
      `Indication Group` = Indication.Group
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(`Number of Visits`)),
  caption = "Summary of Visit Counts and Indication Groups for Each Indication",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    deferRender = TRUE
  ),
  filter = "top"
)
```


### Detail: indications within each indication group {.tabset .tabset-pills}

#### Cancer

```{r supps2-ind-cancer, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## [Analysis / plot]  Supplement > Table S1 · Indication-to-indication-group mappings, with visit counts > Detail: indications within each indication group
## What    : Builds and prints the plot for this section.
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

MedGenData_Indications %>%
  filter(!is.na(Indication_Cleaned), Indication.Group == "Cancer genetics") %>%
  count(Indication_Cleaned, Indication.Group) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(Indication_Cleaned = factor(Indication_Cleaned, levels = unique(Indication_Cleaned))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Indication_Cleaned, y = n, fill = Indication_Cleaned)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5)) +
  ylab("Number of Visits") +
  xlab("Indication") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rep("dodgerblue2", length(unique(MedGenData_Indications$Indication_Cleaned))))
```

```{r supps2-ind-multisystem, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  count(Indication_Cleaned, Indication.Group) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(Indication_Cleaned = factor(Indication_Cleaned, levels = unique(Indication_Cleaned))) %>%
```
